name: Sweden

flag.description: A blue field with a yellow Nordic cross extending to the edges, its vertical arm shifted towards the hoist.
flag.symbolism: The colours come from Sweden's coat of arms, three gold crowns on a blue field.

hook: Sweden is a gold cross on blue: the only Nordic cross in yellow, and the same two colours as Ukraine but laid out as a cross.
trivia: Sweden's National Day, 6 June, is also its Flag Day.
The current flag law dates from 1906, after the union with Norway ended and the union badge in the canton was dropped.
